title: Maricopa County, Arizona, Is Again Ground Zero of Election Conspiracy Theories
gist: Ahead of the midterms, Maricopa County is again the target of election-fraud rumors, driven by an edited clip from a nonpublic camera that was boosted by Kari Lake and Steve Bannon despite an FBI-requested inquiry finding nothing to investigate.

insights.claim: About two weeks before the midterms, election-denial activists are reviving Maricopa County as a symbol of corruption, with President Trump calling it 'a very, very dishonest county'.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Election-trust narratives are being seeded early, raising risk of post-election disputes.
insights.quote: Maricopa is a very, very dishonest county

insights.claim: No evidence of widespread voter fraud in Maricopa County has ever been found, though in March the FBI seized hard drives and servers from the Cyber Ninjas audit.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Federal action keeps the county in the spotlight.
insights.quote: No evidence of widespread voter fraud

insights.claim: A video from We the People USA Alliance showing employees inserting flash drives in the tabulation center drew over 1 million views and was boosted by Kari Lake.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Influencer amplification, including by a senior administration adviser, drives reach.

insights.claim: The clip came from a nonpublic backup livestream camera whose IP address group members allegedly obtained years ago, and the county says the staff were doing authorized software updates on an offline terminal.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Surveillance access lapses are being used to manufacture suspicion.

insights.claim: The FBI-requested Arizona attorney general investigator quickly found nothing to investigate, yet Shelby Busch kept pushing claims on Bannon's War Room and asked DHS and DOJ to act.
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: Debunking does not stop the rumor cycle.

insights.claim: Kate Starbird says Maricopa has become a reusable trope, a ready-to-use building block for new election conspiracy theories.
insights.speaker: Kate Starbird
insights.so_what: Rumors recur through familiar narrative tropes.
insights.quote: a ready-to-use building block for a new rumor or conspiracy theory
